column1: Taking notes, John mutters, "Check for and identify prints on enclosed 4 in. S&W .38 caliber hand gun, Serial# K385557763."
column2: 約翰一邊記錄一邊喃喃說：「檢查並確認隨附四吋史密斯威森 .38 口徑手槍上的指紋，序號 K385557763。」

column1: Making notations, John mumbles under his breath, "Request identification of prints on enclosed fingerprint tape, found in deceased jailer's car."
column2: 約翰記下資料，低聲說：「請鑑識隨附指紋膠帶上的指紋；膠帶是在死者獄卒的車裡找到的。」

column1: Making notations, John mumbles under his breath, "Request identification of print on enclosed fingerprint tape, found in stolen car, at Lytton Airport."
column2: 約翰記下資料，低聲說：「請鑑識隨附指紋膠帶上的指紋；膠帶是在萊頓機場的失竊車輛裡找到的。」

column1: You hand Big John the make-shift 'knife' and request fingerprints, pointing out that it was found underwater.
column2: 你把臨時製成的「刀子」交給大約翰，指出它是在水下找到的，並要求採驗指紋。

column1: You hand the plaster cast footprints to John and request they be checked for size and any unusual marks.
column2: 你把腳印石膏模型交給約翰，請他確認尺寸以及是否有任何異常痕跡。

column1: You submit the bullets from the glovebox of the jailer's car. You request fingerprint and identification analysis.
column2: 你提交從獄卒車輛手套箱裡找到的子彈，要求進行指紋與身分鑑識。

column1: You give the empty holster to Big John, who examines it briefly, and then says, "One holster taken from stolen car."
column2: 你把空槍套交給大約翰。他簡單檢查後說：「從失竊車輛取得槍套一只。」

column1: You turn in the jail clothes and request analysis on the blood spots.
column2: 你交出獄囚服，要求分析上面的血跡。

column1: You turn in the badge you found at the bottom of Clearwater River.
column2: 你交出在清水河底找到的警徽。

column1: You give the victim list to John, and he reads it in astonishment. When he sees your name, he gasps and says, "Whoa, Sonny, you must really be scared."
column2: 你把受害者名單交給約翰。他驚訝地讀著，看到你的名字時倒抽一口氣說：「哇，桑尼，你一定嚇壞了。」

column1: You turn in Colby's business card, and you tell John who Colby is.
column2: 你交出柯比的名片，告訴約翰柯比是誰。

column1: You hand the envelope to Big John, and he examines it and says, "One envelope booked."
column2: 你把信封交給大約翰。他檢查後說：「信封一只，已登錄。」

column1: You hand the corner of the envelope to Big John and tell him how this was held in the hand of a dead guy.
column2: 你把信封角交給大約翰，告訴他這是從死者手中找到的。

column1: Big John says, "You seem to be making progress."
column2: 大約翰說：「看來你有進展。」

column1: I hope you nail Bains soon, says Big John.
column2: 大約翰說：「希望你很快就能逮到班恩斯。」

column1: My, my, we've been BUSY, haven't we? Big John says, smiling.
column2: 大約翰笑著說：「哎呀，我們最近可真忙，不是嗎？」

column1: It doesn't seem you have any evidence to book right now.
column2: 「看來你現在沒有要登錄的證物。」

column1: Wait until he's at the window.
column2: 等他走到窗口。

column1: Book what?
column2: 要登錄什麼？

column1: OK, says John, "What do you have?"
column2: 約翰說：「好，你有什麼？」

column1: That is not something you need to book.
column2: 那不是需要登錄的東西。

column1: Get closer to talk to him.
column2: 靠近一點再和他說話。

column1: Wait until he is at the window.
column2: 等他走到窗口。

column1: Big John looks surprised. "They keep the field kits in the bins right there behind the counter, where they've always been, Bonds," he says.
column2: 大約翰看起來很驚訝。「現場勘查箱一直都放在櫃檯後面那些置物箱裡，邦茲。」他說。

column1: Big John says, "The results will be placed in your message basket tomorrow."
column2: 大約翰說：「鑑識結果明天會放進你的留言籃。」

column1: What do you want to book?
column2: 「你要登錄什麼？」

column1: Give me the evidence you want to book.
column2: 「把你要登錄的證物給我。」

column1: I would be too.
column2: 「我也會。」

column1: That's good. I hope he's found and put away for a long time.
column2: 「那很好。希望能找到他，讓他長期待在牢裡。」

column1: Huh?
column2: 啊？

column1: Ok, then leave me alone.
column2: 「好，那就別煩我了。」

column1: What are you talking about Sonny?
column2: 「你在說什麼，桑尼？」

column1: Boy, Sonny, you must be really brave.
column2: 「孩子，桑尼，你一定真的很勇敢。」

column1: Well, I hope you find something on Bains because who knows what he'll do.
column2: 「嗯，希望你能在班恩斯身上找到線索，誰知道他會做出什麼事。」

column1: Ok, then quit bothering me!
column2: 「好，那就別再煩我了！」

column1: In his heavy Italian accent, Officer Gelepsi says...
column2: 傑雷普西警員用濃重的義大利口音說……

column1: I'da like'a to talk, but I'ma... how do you say... booke' de evidence'
column2: 「偶想跟你聊聊，可是偶……怎麼說……要登錄證物。」

column1: Sonny, I jus' don'a hav'a time to talk.
column2: 「桑尼，偶現在沒時間聊天。」

column1: Cant'a you see I'ma busy?
column2: 「你看不出來偶很忙嗎？」

column1: Look, Mista detective: GET LOST!
column2: 「喂，警探先生：滾開！」

column1: Stop buggin' me, hot-shot! I MEAN it!!
column2: 「別煩我，自以為了不起的傢伙！我是認真的！！」

column1: GO 'WAY! I don' wanna talk to you no more!
column2: 「滾開！我不想再跟你說話！」

column1: In a heated tone of voice Gelepsi says... "Hey, you cock'a de roach'a! Don'a you unnastand'a de english???"
column2: 傑雷普西激動地說……「嘿，你這隻蟑螂！你聽不懂英語嗎？？？」

column1: You hand John the blood sample that you got from Cotton Cove. You ask Big John for identification analysis.
column2: 你把在棉花灣取得的血液樣本交給約翰，請大約翰進行身分鑑識。

column1: Carefully, John takes the blood sample that you got from the trunk. You request identification analysis.
column2: 約翰小心接過你從後車廂取得的血液樣本，你要求進行身分鑑識。

column2: 你要求鑑識在汽車旅館取得的血液樣本。
